reviews.review_description: Amazing developers that interact with the community and show the players secrets and have fun with them. Amazing models and self made assets such as maps, models. And anims which is a breath of fresh air when it comes to Slendytubbies vr games. If you are looking for an amazing passion made love filled Slendytubbies vr game this is the game for you the other ones suck so bad I didn’t expect much but this blew my expectations out of the water and is just an overall amazing experience. My only issue is that the ai seems to lose the player very easy but other then that an amazing project, can’t wait to play the survival mode once that is released. <3
